paper_title: BICEP / Keck XIV: Improved constraints on axion-like polarization oscillations in the cosmic microwave background
notes: BICEP/Keck XIV (arXiv:2108.03316): search for axion-like CMB polarization oscillations using Keck Array 2012-2015 data. Observed 95%-CL upper limits on g_phi_gamma for m in 1e-23 to 1e-18 eV, assuming axions are all of DM (kappa=1) with local density rho0=0.3 GeV/cm^3. Data points computed from the paper's smoothed analytic limit Eq. 15: g < 4.3e-12 GeV^-1 * sinc^-1(m/5.0e-19 eV) * (m/1e-21 eV) * [1 - 2(m0/m)^2(1-cos(m/m0))]^{-1/2} with m0=1.9e-23 eV; consistent with the flat-region result Eq. 16 (g < 4.5e-12 GeV^-1 * m/1e-21 eV for 1.6e-21 <= m <= 4.8e-20 eV). No new parameter space excluded relative to existing bounds, but a genuinely new measured limit from this observable.
